findings.summary: The repo-wide shadow scan is non-hermetic: it walks every file under the repo root excluding only .git/.dev-dispatch/.dd-evidence/.venv/__pycache__, so gitignored build and tool caches that are present in the tree (.pytest_cache/, .ruff_cache/, and any future .mypy_cache/, build/, dist/, *.egg-info/) are read byte-wise and can turn the assertion red on content no one authored. I verified every such file currently present is clean, and the exclusion set is exactly the one the spec froze, so this is conformant as specified -- flagged only as future flake surface; anchoring the walk on tracked files would make it deterministic.

Machine-namespace metadata inconsistency, outside this spec's surface and non-blocking: the committed implement handoff records work_head_commit b77272ef8d3d41a803034c54f7f66f349fe7d444, while the dispatch context supplied to this review states the product commit / work_head_commit is bfca7d97af62d24258bc52e16bc1ac19725895bc. Consistent with a metadata-only materialization stacked on the actor's product commit, and the product content in the subject tree satisfies the spec either way, so this is not treated as a divergence finding; surfaced for the seal's chain-of-custody record.
